implementation_summary: Successfully added RayQuery and AccelerationStructure feature detection, conditional enabling, and explicit logging to VulkanContext

changes: Added m_supportsRayQuery and m_supportsAccelerationStructure member variables
Added getter methods supportsRayQuery() and supportsAccelerationStructure()
Added extension checking for VK_KHR_RAY_QUERY_EXTENSION_NAME and VK_KHR_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_EXTENSION_NAME
Conditional enabling of ray query and acceleration structure features based on support
Conditional addition of RT extensions to device extension list
Added explicit logging after device creation showing RT support status
Fixed pNext chain to preserve all features (atomic float -> acceleration structure -> ray query -> mesh shader -> vk12 -> vk13 -> vk14)

validation_results.validation_errors: None related to RT feature enabling

acceptance_criteria_met: ✅ logs/run.txt contains the three support lines once per run
✅ Application runs without new validation errors
✅ m_supportsRayQuery and m_supportsAccelerationStructure reflect actual enablement (both true on RTX 4060 Ti)
notes: pNext chain properly maintained without overwriting pointers. RT features are now conditionally enabled based on hardware support, preventing issues on non-RT GPUs.
